findings.problem: The Spanish card preguntar-ask (to ask a question, not ask for something) has the same meaning, so its picture of someone asking a question fits this card.

back.target: to put, to place (upright), to set; in eine Frage stellen: to ask (a question)
back.example: May I ask you a question?

note: This card teaches stellen only in the fixed phrase eine Frage stellen, and the hint is what makes stellen the single right answer.
